tool: Pixparkle Chat-Based Image and Video Generator

criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Reference images and same-chat image-to-video are documented; exact ASIN identity during animation is untested.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: No saved AIVP video or independent artifact-backed benchmark.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Multi-turn image refinement is documented; animation controls and cross-run video consistency are unknown.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Reference-led image creation, refinement and video conversion remain in one chat; final video editing/export workflow is unclear.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: No controlled video timing, queue or error evidence.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Ten no-card credits and image plan economics are published; video credit cost and usable-output cost are unknown.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Commercial use and user ownership are documented, subject to third-party rights and provider terms.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: No public API verified; terms prohibit automated tools or bots from accessing the service.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Browser product/ecommerce workflow fits creators; Australia-specific billing and support are unverified.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: No verified affiliate programme or AIVP tracking.

analysis: Useful reference-led conversational handoff from product image to short video, but video-specific limits, cost, quality and automation are unresolved.
confidence_notes: Primary vendor documents and distribution listings only; no controlled AIVP run.

hard_gates.product_affiliate: Not approved until exact mask identity remains distinctive in the first 10 seconds across three outputs.
hard_gates.publication: First Look only; no output evidence.
hard_gates.integration: Browser automation prohibited by current terms; do not integrate without written permission or public API.
